column1: # Known false positives of the DAST lane (scripts/dast-lane.mjs): <ZAP rule id>, tab, <URL regex>,
# tab, the evidence that the alert is false. The lane marks their alerts False Positive in the
# report and out of scope for ZAP's exit; every entry needs a contract note. ZAP repeats every
# query parameter in each URL, so the regex requires the probe in createdAfter's own value.

column3: KN-10: createdAfter is parsed as a date before any query, and every value that is not one answers the same 400
